title: Angel Beats!: Heaven’s Door
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a school-like world after death, Yuri leads the Shinda Sekai Sensen (SSS) in rebellion against the god who gave her an unreasonable life, using guns against Tenshi, the student-council chair with supernatural powers (AniList blurb). Based on the Angel Beats! Track Zero novel and tied to the Angel Beats! anime (AniList; MU). Eleven volumes, complete; MU notes the English version was dropped.
life_message: Those dealt unfair lives refuse to accept fate quietly and find meaning together.
